about: The Katana's two-handed block hit (KE task 10): Parry1H01's right guard hit at its own speed (the director fits it to the blockstun), made two-handed by the guard's pass (6 cm clear of the body, as the parry's raised blade allows; 8 cm leaves the hands off the handle on its first frames), the one-handed grip keeping the pack's clip as it is. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
